main.description: A covenant-keeping OFFER (縁の申し出) from a keeper to a kept candidate. Refusable, expirable, cooldown-bound (G3 anti-pestering). NEVER creates an active bond by itself — consent (bondCovenant) is a separate, kept-signed record.

keeperDid.description: → :mishmeret.bond/keeper. The one who offers to keep.

keptDid.description: → :mishmeret.bond/kept. The one offered the covenant. G4 INVARIANT — the offer is addressed to and visible to this party; there is no keeper-only hidden state.

synthetic.description: G7 INVARIANT — true at R0 (fictional DIDs only). Real-roster offers are Council + operator gated.

ceremonyRef.description: → :mishmeret.bond/ceremony. Optional musubi 結 ceremony record (shomer vow, ADR-2606112300 §D5).
